name: Cash baseline
fee_treatment: No trading fees; disclose cash yield policy
selection_rule: Pre-register before any candidate results are inspected

name: Buy and hold baseline
comparison_basis: Unrebalanced exposure to the same instrument
required_data: Same point-in-time instrument prices and coverage
fee_treatment: Include entry and exit fees and funding where applicable
validity_limit: Does not match strategy turnover or risk

name: Equal weight baseline
comparison_basis: Equal allocation across the declared universe
required_data: Same point-in-time universe membership and prices
fee_treatment: Use the same fee and slippage policy
validity_limit: Capacity and survivorship assumptions must be disclosed

name: Training class-prior baseline
comparison_basis: Constant probability from training labels only
required_data: Same training split target and label horizon
fee_treatment: Report identical scoring and evaluation windows
selection_rule: Freeze training split before model comparison
validity_limit: Not a trading strategy and not a market benchmark

name: No defensible benchmark
fee_treatment: Report all costs required by the objective
selection_rule: Use only with written rationale before evaluation
validity_limit: No relative-performance promotion claim is permitted
